# Data Integrity Checklist: Cart API Integration

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability of requirements for authoritative cart data and exact financial values.
**Created**: 2026-11-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Primary Actor/Timing**: Author self-review before handing the requirements to peers or implementation.
**Focus**: Financial accuracy and authoritative cart data; Standard PR gate depth.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every authoritative cart field represented in the cart view? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are item-count and selected-totals requirements specified as distinct outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements specified for every financial field that must preserve a supplied numeric value? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for display-only fields absent from the authoritative contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for reconciled cart values, quantities, selections, and availability reasons? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements specified for header badge values after every authoritative cart result? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "supplied numeric value" defined precisely enough to determine formatting and precision expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the existing Vietnamese currency style specified with a concrete example and grouping rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "authoritative cart data" unambiguously scoped to the OpenAPI contract and cart endpoints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "selected" and "purchasable" criteria clear enough to determine which items contribute to totals? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "distinct cart rows" clearly defined for the header count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "reconciled" defined clearly enough to distinguish authoritative values from prior local values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are count requirements consistent between the cart view and the header badge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK014 Are money-handling requirements consistent across user stories, functional requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Do reconciliation requirements align with the clarification that no separate change notice is required? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK016 Are unavailable-item requirements consistent across selection, totals, and edge-case sections? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK017 Are voucher clearing and discount requirements consistent with the no-client-calculation rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-030]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are financial-accuracy success criteria measurable as an exact match with authoritative data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Can the header badge success criterion be objectively measured after each cart change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the performance target quantified with metric, percentile, and connection condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK021 Are placeholder-field success criteria measurable and tied to explicit temporary marking? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-034, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK022 Are unavailable-item success criteria measurable for marking, selection exclusion, and total exclusion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary scenarios defined for all eight user stories? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for authoritative cart results after a sign-in return? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for authoritative results after add, quantity, variant, selection, removal, and voucher changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK026 Are loading and empty-cart scenarios documented as distinct requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK027 Are guest access and session-expiry scenarios documented with return-destination requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are quantity boundary requirements specified for 1 and 999 plus invalid quantities? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for out-of-stock, unavailable, missing-price, and cleared-selection reconciliation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements specified for rapid repeated actions and failed or superseded updates? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-031, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK031 Are network and server failure requirements specified with retry semantics? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK032 Is precision-loss risk addressed in requirements for large VND money values? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements specified for vouchers that become ineligible after selection changes? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-030]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are authorization requirements specified for all protected cart information? [Security, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK035 Are accessibility requirements documented for selection controls, quantity controls, and voucher status messages? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK036 Are performance requirements tied to a specific cart journey and measurement conditions? [Performance, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK037 Are scope requirements explicit that checkout and order placement are excluded? [Scope, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK038 Are visual-preservation requirements stated with objective comparison criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Is the authoritative API contract source explicitly identified and its existence validated in the requirements? [Dependency, Spec §Input]
- [ ] CHK040 Are assumptions about the existing sign-in return path documented as dependencies? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Are assumptions about product-detail variant identity documented as dependencies? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Are assumptions about Vietnamese reason text documented and sourced from authoritative reason values? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK043 Is the wording about showing money exactly as supplied reconciled with the requirement to use Vietnamese formatting? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK044 Is "item count" consistently defined across cart rows, unselected rows, unavailable rows, and the header badge? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK045 Are placeholder requirements for original price and delivery estimate explicitly marked as temporary? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK046 Are voucher-clearing requirements limited to supplied reasons without inventing new values? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK047 Are automated and manual verification expectations stated without implying implementation completeness? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
